Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_GR IN ('02','22','23')

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 ORDER BY C.AC_NAME

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.AC_NAME
SELECT CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,AC_NAME FROM SL_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '
SELECT CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,AC_NAME FROM PR_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

Select Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt FROM (AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ?

Select B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.CO_YEAR,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.CLR_DATE,A.CHQ_NO,A.LEDR_KEY,A.LD_CODE As AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,B.MAIN_BOOK,C.AC_AREA, Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt FROM (AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.LD_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.CO_YEAR,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.CLR_DATE,A.CHQ_NO,A.LEDR_KEY,A.LD_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,B.MAIN_BOOK,C.AC_AREA ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,B.BOOK_NAME,A.VCH_NO

' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? CO_BOOK ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? VCH_NO ? ' AND A.SR_NO = ? LEDR_KEY ? LEDR_KEY ? LEDR_KEY ?
